name: on_populate
title: world.on_populate
lead: Each chunk the overworld terrain made, once, after it made it.

usedIn.quote: trees and sea level 63. Scripts only add to it (`world.on_populate`).
`world.on_populate` are single-handler setters: a later call replaces the

world.on_populate(function(chunk) end)   -- once per chunk the overworld terrain made, after it made it
